mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT b.tenant_id as tenantId,b.tenant_name as tenantName,o.is_operation as isOperation,b.trade_info,od.device_code,od.app_ver_code, od.industry_code, GROUP_CONCAT( IF ( o.operation_type = '2', o.operation_alarm_type_str, null) ) AS parallel_alarm_type_str, GROUP_CONCAT( IF ( o.operation_type = '1', o.operation_alarm_type_str, null) ) AS serial_alarm_type_str, GROUP_CONCAT( o.operation_type ) AS operation_type, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT NULLIF( CASE WHEN o.operation_type = '2' THEN o.operation_node END, '' )) AS parallelOperationNode, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT NULLIF( CASE WHEN o.operation_type = '1' THEN o.operation_node END, '' )) AS operationNode, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT NULLIF( CASE WHEN o.operation_type = '2' THEN o.operation_dept END, '' )) AS parallelOperationDept, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT NULLIF( CASE WHEN o.operation_type = '1' THEN o.operation_dept END, '' )) AS operationDept, GROUP_CONCAT(o.alarm_source) AS operation_alarm_source, c.trigger_rule triggerRule FROM sys_tenant_info b LEFT JOIN vm_order_devices od on od.tenant_id = b.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_operation_config o ON o.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND o.delete_flag = '0' and (o.alarm_source = #{param.alarmSource} or o.alarm_source = '-1')
and o.accept_node = #{param.localNode}
LEFT JOIN vm_algorithm_give_config c on b.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and od.industry_code = c.industry_code and od.device_code = c.device_code where od.delete_flag = '0'
and od.app_ver_code = #{applicationCode}
and c.algorithm_code = #{param.algorithmCode} and c.alarm_type = #{param.alarmType} and c.device_code = #{deviceCode} and c.channel_code = #{param.channelCode} and c.second_switch = '0'
and c.alarm_type = #{param.alarmType} and c.device_code = #{deviceCode} and c.channel_code = #{param.channelCode} and c.second_switch = '1'
and c.delete_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' and od.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) GROUP BY b.tenant_id,od.industry_code

SELECT distinct alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, type_name AS typeName, type_value AS typeValue, if_free AS ifFree, icon FROM sys_alarm_type WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND type_value = #{warningTypeId} limit 1

select su.user_id, su.dept_id, su.user_name, su.user_type, su.nick_name, su.email, su.avatar, su.phonenumber, su.sex, su.status, su.del_flag, su.login_ip, su.login_date, su.create_by, su.remark, su.login_fail_num, su.enterprise_id, su.tenant_id, su.is_tenant_admin from sys_user su where su.is_tenant_admin = '1' AND su.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND su.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(b.nick_name) FROM bm_gridkeeper a LEFT JOIN sys_user b ON a.staff_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN bm_grid_keeper_ref d ON a.keeper_id = d.keeper_id and d.delete_flag = '0' WHERE d.grid_id = #{gridId} and a.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT b.nick_name AS nikeName,a.keeper_type AS keeperType FROM bm_gridkeeper a LEFT JOIN sys_user b ON a.staff_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN bm_grid_keeper_ref d ON a.keeper_id = d.keeper_id and d.delete_flag = '0' WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' and d.grid_id = #{gridId} and b.nick_name IS NOT NULL and b.nick_name !=""

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(b.user_id) FROM bm_gridkeeper a LEFT JOIN sys_user b ON a.staff_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN bm_grid_keeper_ref d ON a.keeper_id = d.keeper_id and d.delete_flag = '0' WHERE d.grid_id = #{gridId} and a.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT a.latitude, a.longitude, a.location, a.province_id, a.city_id, a.county_id, a.height, a.model_code AS modelId, p.area_name AS provinceName, ci.area_name AS cityName, co.area_name AS countyName, a.alarm_location, t.focus_range as focusRange, t.verti_down_neg as vertiDownNeg,
ct.channel_name as channelName,
a.device_name, a.image_url AS deviceImageUrl, a.category_code AS deviceType, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'device_type' AND DICT_VALUE = a.category_code LIMIT 1 ) as deviceTypeName, a.device_sub_type AS deviceSubType, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'device_subtype' AND DICT_VALUE = a.device_sub_type LIMIT 1 ) as deviceSubTypeName FROM vm_device_info_t a left join vm_device_model_t t on a.device_model_code = t.device_model_code and a.model_code = t.mfgr_code LEFT JOIN sys_area p ON a.province_id = p.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area ci ON a.city_id = ci.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area co ON a.county_id = co.area_code
LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t ct ON ct.device_code = a.device_code and ct.channel_code = #{channelCode}
WHERE a.delete_flag = '0'
and a.device_code = #{deviceCode}
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.latitude, a.longitude, a.province_id, a.city_id, a.county_id, a.device_code, a.device_name, a.location, p.area_name AS provinceName, ci.area_name AS cityName, co.area_name AS countyName FROM vm_iot_device_t a LEFT JOIN sys_area p ON a.province_id = p.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area ci ON a.city_id = ci.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area co ON a.county_id = co.area_code WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' AND a.category_code = 2 AND a.device_code in
#{item}

select sd.dept_id,sd.dept_name from sys_dept sd
sd.`STATUS` = '0' AND sd.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND sd.dept_id in
#{item}
SELECT area_code as region_code, area_name as region_name FROM sys_area WHERE `status` = '1' OR del_flag = '0'
SELECT type_value, type_name, ifnull(icon,'') as icon FROM sys_alarm_type WHERE SOURCE = '0' AND delete_flag = '0'

SELECT DISTINCT GROUP_CONCAT(t1.DEPT_NAME) org_name,t2.NICK_NAME nickName,t2.PHONENUMBER mobile_phone,t2.USER_NAME userName FROM sys_dept t1,sys_user t2 WHERE FIND_IN_SET(t1.dept_id,t2.dept_id) AND t2.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.DEL_FLAG = 0 AND t1.`STATUS`= '0' AND t2.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND t2.`STATUS`= '0'

SELECT DISTINCT od.device_code AS deviceCode, ( CASE WHEN length( IFNULL( ten.device_name, '' )) = 0 THEN m.device_name ELSE ten.device_name END ) device_name FROM vm_order_sensor_devices od LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t m ON m.device_code = od.device_code AND m.category_code = 2 LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t ten ON ten.device_code = od.device_code AND ten.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND ten.delete_flag = '0' AND ten.industry_code = od.industry_code WHERE od.delete_flag = '0' AND od.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) AND m.delete_flag = '0' AND od.category_code = 2 AND od.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId}
AND (od.device_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.iotDeviceCodeOrName},'%') OR (ten.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.iotDeviceCodeOrName},'%')) OR (m.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.iotDeviceCodeOrName},'%')))

select distinct a.user_id,a.USER_NAME,a.tenant_id,b.role_Id from sys_user a left join sys_user_role b on a.user_id = b.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = b.role_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'leader_role'
and a.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId};

select distinct a.user_id userId,a.NICK_NAME userName,b.role_Id roleId,a.dept_id deptId,a.USER_NAME nickName,a.AVATAR avatar from sys_user a left join sys_user_role b on a.user_id = b.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = b.role_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'leader_role'
and a.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId};

select dm.model_id as id, 0 as z0,dm.min_focus as f0, 1 as n, 1 as `m`,dm.pic_sensor_width as d, dm.pic_sensor_length as c , d.device_code , d.model_code as model_id ,dm.focus_range, dm.verti_down_neg from vm_device_info_t d join vm_device_model_t dm on d.device_model_code = dm.device_model_code and d.model_code = dm.mfgr_code where d.device_code = #{deviceCode}
SELECT pan,hor_offset as horOffset,pitch_offset as pitchOffset FROM vm_device_ref_point_valid_t where device_code = #{deviceCode} and point_flag = '1' order by pan asc

SELECT a.latitude, a.longitude, a.location, a.province_id, a.city_id, a.county_id, a.height, a.model_code AS modelId, p.area_name AS provinceName, ci.area_name AS cityName, co.area_name AS countyName, a.device_code as deviceCode, a.device_name AS deviceName, a.alarm_location, a.image_url AS deviceImageUrl FROM vm_device_info_t a LEFT JOIN sys_area p ON a.province_id = p.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area ci ON a.city_id = ci.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area co ON a.county_id = co.area_code WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' and a.device_code in
#{code}

SELECT COALESCE(a.device_code, n.device_code) AS deviceCode, COALESCE(a.device_name, n.device_name) AS deviceName FROM vm_uav_nest_device_info n LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_info_t a ON n.device_code = a.uav_nest_code AND a.delete_flag = '0' WHERE n.delete_flag = '0' AND (a.device_code = #{deviceCode} OR n.device_code = #{deviceCode})

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM vm_user_device_collection_t t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.coll_obj_code = #{collObjCode} AND t.coll_obj_type = #{collObjType} ) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END deviceCodeCollect FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: insert into sys_history_logs_api (`type`,url,original_json,request_json,response_json, create_time,expend_time,status,error, customer_code,alarm_code) VALUES (#{type},#{url}, #{originalJson},#{requestJson},#{responseJson}, now(),#{expendTime},#{status},#{error},#{customerCode},#{alarmCode})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT device_code FROM vm_order_devices WHERE customer_code = #{customerCode} AND delete_flag = '0' and ord_status in (0,1,2)
SELECT DISTINCT channel_codes_str FROM vm_order_devices WHERE customer_code = #{customerCode} AND delete_flag = '0' and ord_status in (0,1,2)

SELECT dev.county_id countyId, area.AREA_NAME as region_name, dev.location, dev.latitude, dev.longitude, dev.device_code deviceCode FROM vm_device_info_t dev LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON dev.county_id = area.AREA_CODE WHERE dev.delete_flag = '0' AND area.DEL_FLAG = '0' and dev.device_code in
#{item}

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.DEPT_ID = u.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN sys_area_manage_rel samr ON samr.dept_code = u.DEPT_ID WHERE r.role_key = 'tower_role_32' AND u.STATUS = '0' AND u.USER_TYPE = '0' AND u.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND ( d.DEPT_LEVEL='1' OR ( d.DEPT_LEVEL = '2' AND LEFT ( samr.area_code , 4 ) = #{provinceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) OR ( d.DEPT_LEVEL > '2' AND LEFT ( samr.area_code , 6 ) = #{cityId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) )
SELECT count(1) from vm_radar_alarm_template where delete_flag ='0' and template_status = '1' and task_id =#{taskId}

select tenant_id,industry_code, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(app_ver_code ORDER BY create_time DESC),',',1) app_ver_code from vm_order_package where delete_flag = '0' and ord_status in ('0','1','2')
( tenant_id = #{item.tenantId} and industry_code = #{item.industryCode} )
GROUP BY tenant_id,industry_code
SELECT platform_name platformName from vm_platform_data_config where delete_flag = '0' and platform_code =#{platformCode} limit 1
SELECT algorithm_name AS algorithmName FROM vm_algorithm_info_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' and app_scenarios = '1' AND algorithm_code = #{algorithmCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LIMIT 1
SELECT platform_code platformCode from vm_platform_data_config where delete_flag = '0' and platform_code != '10000000001'
SELECT plan_task_id taskRecordId, reality_time realityTime, plan_time planTime, fly_time flyTime FROM vm_air_task_t WHERE plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId}

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id,u.dept_id FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.DEPT_ID = u.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN sys_area_manage_rel samr ON samr.dept_code = u.DEPT_ID WHERE r.role_key = 'tower_role_32' AND u.STATUS = '0' AND u.USER_TYPE = '0' AND u.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND ( d.DEPT_LEVEL='1' OR ( d.DEPT_LEVEL = '2' AND LEFT ( samr.area_code , 4 ) = #{provinceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) OR ( d.DEPT_LEVEL > '2' AND LEFT ( samr.area_code , 6 ) = #{cityId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) )
SELECT count(1) FROM vm_algorithm_info_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND algorithm_code = #{algorithmCode} AND algorithm_model_type = #{modelType}
